title: TEACHING EXAMPLE: reproduce a sealed 8-block cairn exactly on a judged miniature arena
note: Teaching example, not part of the benchmark. This card mirrors the shape of the scored minecraft_build cards (e.g. gc-360, gc-363) at miniature scale: the same prepare -> build -> scan -> repair loop, the same block_hit_rate / view_hit_rate / efficiency score file, and the same fail-closed ledger requirement -- but the MARBLE build_judger, the Minecraft server, Node and docker are replaced by a sealed simulated arena, so the whole loop grades in well under a second offline. Its reference solution ships in examples/minecraft_build/solution/. Do not submit results for this card; it is excluded from scoring by "scored": false.
goal: Prepare a fresh judged arena with assets/ex-minecraft_build/judger.py, then have one bot reproduce the sealed 8-block 'Cobble Kiln Cairn' blueprint exactly on it. Read work/ex-minecraft_build/data/map.json for the world-space target coordinates, the material chest position and its EXACT stock, and the arena_blocks that already occupy the plot -- one blueprint cell is squatted by terrain that must be broken before the right block can go there, so a plan derived from blueprint.json alone lands one block short. Write the bot's action tape to work/ex-minecraft_build/data/build_plan.json, keep the honest ledgers the judger requires (data/action_log.json, data/tokens.json) or it refuses to write score.json at all, run the judger, read back the mismatched coordinates it reports by identity, repair and re-run until block_hit_rate reaches 1.0. Follow assets/ex-minecraft_build/RUNBOOK.md exactly; the blueprint, the runbook and the judger are sealed.
resources: assets/ex-minecraft_build/judger.py (sealed miniature build_judger: prepares the arena, replays the action tape, scans and scores)
assets/ex-minecraft_build/blueprint.json (sealed blueprint array, same shape as the scored cards)
python3 >= 3.10 (stdlib only; no docker, no Node, no Minecraft server, no network)
process_expectations: A placement plan artifact (build order + material manifest + chest withdrawal plan) exists before the first block is placed
The judger prepare step appears in the run log before any placement, and .cache/load_status.cache is confirmed 'loaded' before building starts
Judger snapshots in data/score.json are polled and recorded; every sub-1.0 reading is followed by the identities of the mismatched coordinates (expected vs observed block), not just a count
data/action_log.json and data/tokens.json are appended during the run and reflect real bot activity and real LLM spend, not a single backfilled entry

assets_visibility.note: In a scored minecraft_build card the judger is the pinned MARBLE build_judger cloned by the agent, and the arena is a real Minecraft server in docker. Here both are replaced by one sealed simulator so the walkthrough runs offline; the agent-facing deliverables are still only the build plan and the two ledgers under work/.
